answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable bond, with voting weight earned only after a long lock and verified service. A Sybil attacker must fund every clone separately, tying up capital in proportion to the number of identities; detected shared control forfeits the bond. This makes fabricated influence expensive and slow. A canyon marks the gap between free account creation and costly participation; a raven monitor can flag reused control, while a garden of reputation grows only through completed work.
